history.summary: A 409 sqft freehold shoebox 1BR at Silverscape, a boutique D14 (Dakota/Geylang) block built 2015, at $689k / $1,685 psf. Low quantum and freehold are pluses, but resale-only appreciation is a weak 1.5%/yr on a thin 14-txn series, PSF sits slightly above the $1,611 median, and it's a tiny shoebox in a small block 730m from MRT.
history.rating_rationale: Sub-$700k freehold quantum near Dakota MRT/CCL gives an easy rental entry, but the investment case is thin: 1.5%/yr resale appreciation (essentially flat in real terms), only 14 transactions, asking PSF a touch over median, and a 409 sqft shoebox in a boutique block — a format that lags on capital growth and has shallow resale demand. A yield/parking play at best, not a growth buy.

history.summary: A freehold 409 sqft micro-shoebox in inner Lorong 32 Geylang asking $1,685 psf in a 45-unit boutique block. The appreciation signal is a regional_baseline placeholder (no real project data) and the asking sits above the most recent ~$1,601 psf comp, while the development has only 26 sales in its entire history — a thin-data, low-quantum unit whose 'cheapness' is unverified and whose Geylang location caps demand.
history.rating_rationale: Appreciation_source is 'regional_baseline', meaning the 3.7% figure is a synthetic fallback, not a measured project CAGR — exactly the data quirk v3.4 priors warn against. The asking $1,684.60 psf is above the latest available comp (~$1,601 psf) and the psf_premium_vs_cohort is +6.0% on only 5 cohort txns, so the -10.4% age-adj cheapness is not corroborated by same-size sales. The project is a 45-unit boutique with just 26 lifetime sale transactions — illiquid. Location is inner Lorong 32 Geylang; while near Aljunied EW9 / Dakota CC8, the red-light-district adjacency limits owner-occupier demand and can complicate financing/LTV on resale. The only genuine positives are the freehold tenure and the very low $689K quantum. Net: a fairly-to-slightly-richly priced, illiquid niche unit — Neutral with low confidence given the thin/synthetic data.

Tiny 45-unit project, only 26 sales in its entire history — very poor liquidity
Inner Lorong 32 Geylang (red-light proximity) limits owner-occupier demand and can affect financing
